tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List Oncast radio channels (English, and Tech and Money in Mexican Spanish). Each channel includes its oncast.fm listen URL. No listener counts and no internal settings.

tools.name: latest_stories
tools.description: Latest fact-checked Oncast stories. Only claims that reached a verdict (TRUE, FALSE, or MISLEADING) and have an original source link are included. Every story has source links and an oncast.fm URL: cite both. Call get_story for what the hosts said. This does not start a broadcast.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search recent verified Oncast stories by keyword. Matches titles, fact-check summaries, sources, and what the hosts said. Each hit includes source links and an oncast.fm URL. Cite both.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One verified Oncast story: summary, fact-check verdict and notes, original source links, what the hosts said, published time, the oncast.fm story URL, and a listen link. Cite the story URL and the sources.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_channels, search_stories, get_story · Public sink: latest_stories.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_channels, search_stories, get_story · Public sink: latest_stories

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
